title: Intertwining the line bundle and Grauert-tube Hardy quantizations of the round 2-sphere
summary: We compare two natural Hardy quantizations carried by the unit cosphere bundle of the round two-sphere. Through $S^2\simeq CP^1$, the cosphere bundle is the unit circle bundle of the canonical bundle $O(-2)$, and its Hardy space assembles the section spaces $H^0(CP^1,O(2\ell))$. Through the real-analytic round metric, the imaginary-time exponential map identifies the same cosphere bundle with every Grauert-tube boundary carrying the adapted complex structure, whose Reeb flow is the geodesic flow.
